Acme Cloud Terms of Service
Last updated: March 3, 2026. Acme Cloud is a fictional company created for testing purposes only; any resemblance to a real service is coincidental.

1. Acceptance of These Terms
These Terms of Service (the “Terms”) form a binding agreement between you and Acme Cloud Inc. (“Acme”, “we”, “us”). By creating an account, installing our desktop or mobile applications, or otherwise accessing the Acme Cloud storage and collaboration services (the “Service”), you confirm that you have read, understood and agree to be bound by these Terms and by our Privacy Notice, which is incorporated by reference. If you are using the Service on behalf of an organization, you represent that you have authority to bind that organization to these Terms. If you do not agree, you must not use the Service.

You must be at least 18 years old, or the age of legal majority where you live, to create an account. You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for all activity that occurs under your account. You agree to notify us promptly if you suspect unauthorized access to your account. We are not responsible for losses caused by your failure to protect your credentials.

2. Description of the Service
Acme Cloud provides online file storage, file synchronization across devices, document previews, shared folders and basic collaboration features such as comments and version history. Features vary by plan and may be added, changed or removed over time. Some features rely on third-party infrastructure providers located in different countries, and the availability of the Service may depend on those providers. We do our best to keep the Service available, but we do not promise that it will be uninterrupted or error-free, and scheduled maintenance may occasionally make parts of the Service unavailable.

3. Subscriptions, Billing and Renewal
Paid plans are offered on a monthly or annual basis. Prices are displayed in your account settings before you subscribe, and applicable taxes are added at checkout. By starting a paid subscription you authorize Acme to charge your selected payment method for the subscription fee and any applicable taxes.
Your subscription will automatically renew at the end of each billing period and your payment method will be charged the then-current fee unless you cancel at least 48 hours before the renewal date. Cancellation can only be completed by contacting our billing team through the support portal; deleting the app or your files does not cancel your subscription.

All payments are non-refundable, including for partially used subscription periods and for storage you did not use, except where a refund is required by applicable law. If a payment fails, we may suspend paid features until the outstanding balance is paid, and we may retry the charge using any payment method on file.
Promotional prices and free trials are available only to new customers, are limited to one per household, and convert into a regular paid subscription at the end of the promotional period unless cancelled in the same way described above.

4. Your Content and the License You Grant
You keep ownership of the files, documents, images and other material that you upload or create with the Service (“User Content”). You are solely responsible for your User Content and for making sure you have the rights necessary to upload and share it.
By uploading User Content, you grant Acme a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, copy, modify, publicly display and distribute any content you upload (“User Content”), including for promotional purposes, and to sublicense these rights to our affiliates and partners.

We may use your content and usage data to train our AI models and improve our machine learning systems, including models that are offered to other customers. Data used for this purpose may be retained after you delete the original files.
You must not upload content that is unlawful, that infringes the intellectual property rights of others, or that contains malware. We may remove content that we reasonably believe violates these Terms, and we may report illegal content to the competent authorities.

5. Acceptable Use
You agree not to misuse the Service. In particular, you will not attempt to probe, scan or test the vulnerability of our systems without written permission, interfere with other users’ access to the Service, use the Service to send unsolicited bulk messages, reverse engineer our applications except where the law permits it, or use automated means to create accounts. We may investigate suspected violations and cooperate with law enforcement where appropriate.

Shared links are visible to anyone who has the link. You are responsible for choosing the right sharing settings for your folders, and for revoking links that should no longer be active. Acme is not responsible for the actions of people with whom you share content.

6. Privacy and Data
Our Privacy Notice explains what personal data we collect, including account details, device identifiers, approximate location derived from your IP address, and information about how you use the Service. We use this information to operate and secure the Service, to provide customer support, and to understand how our features are used. We keep backup copies of deleted files for up to 30 days so that they can be restored if they were removed by mistake.

7. Data Sharing with Partners
In addition to the purposes described in our Privacy Notice, we may sell your personal information, including your contact details, device identifiers and inferred interests, to advertising and data analytics partners, who may combine it with other data they hold about you.
You can review the list of partner categories in your account settings. Partners are contractually required to process the information in line with applicable law.

8. Changes to the Service and to These Terms
We are constantly improving the Service and may add or remove features. We may modify these Terms at any time without notice, and your continued use of the Service after the changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms. It is your responsibility to review these Terms periodically.

9. Termination
You may stop using the Service at any time. We may suspend or terminate your access to the Service if you materially breach these Terms, if we are required to do so by law, or if your account has been inactive for more than two years. Where reasonable, we will give you an opportunity to export your files before termination. Sections that by their nature should survive termination, including those on licenses, liability and dispute resolution, will survive.

10. Disclaimers and Limitation of Liability
The Service is provided “as is” and “as available”. To the maximum extent permitted by law, Acme disclaims all warranties, express or implied, including warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose and non-infringement.
To the maximum extent permitted by law, Acme’s total liability for any claim arising out of or relating to these Terms or the Service is limited to the amount you paid to Acme in the three months before the event giving rise to the claim. Acme is not liable for indirect, incidental, special or consequential damages, or for loss of data, profits or goodwill.

11. Dispute Resolution
Please contact our support team first if you have a concern; most issues can be resolved quickly and informally. If we cannot resolve a dispute within 60 days, the procedure in this section applies.
You and Acme agree that any dispute arising out of or relating to these Terms or the Service will be resolved exclusively by binding individual arbitration, and you waive any right to a jury trial or to participate in a class action lawsuit or class-wide arbitration. The arbitrator may award relief only on an individual basis.

The arbitration will be administered by a recognized arbitration provider under its consumer rules. You may opt out of this arbitration agreement by sending written notice to our legal department within 30 days of first accepting these Terms.

12. Governing Law
These Terms are governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to its conflict of laws principles. Subject to the arbitration section above, the state and federal courts located in Wilmington, Delaware will have exclusive jurisdiction over any claim not subject to arbitration.

12a. Third-Party Services and Integrations
The Service may let you connect third-party applications, such as office suites, calendar tools, password managers or photo editors. When you connect an integration, you authorize Acme to exchange the data needed for that integration to work, such as file names, file contents you choose to open, and basic account details. Third-party services are governed by their own terms and privacy notices, which you should read before connecting them. Acme does not control and is not responsible for third-party services, their availability, or the way they handle your information, and we may disable an integration if it creates a security risk for our users.

Some integrations are offered by Acme partners under co-branded names. The partner is responsible for the features it provides, and support requests about those features should be sent to the partner directly. We will tell you in the integration settings which company provides each feature, and you can disconnect an integration at any time from your account page.

12b. Beta Features and Feedback
From time to time we may invite you to try features that are still in development and are labelled as beta, preview or experimental. Beta features may be less reliable than the rest of the Service, may change significantly, and may be discontinued at any time. Please do not rely on beta features to store the only copy of important files. Your use of beta features is voluntary, and you can opt out of preview programs in your account settings.

If you send us comments, suggestions or ideas about the Service, we may use them to improve our products without any obligation to you. We appreciate feedback and read every message sent to the product team, although we cannot reply to all of them individually.

12c. Storage Limits, Fair Use and Inactive Files
Each plan includes a storage allowance that is shown on the pricing page and in your account. If you exceed your allowance, you will not be able to upload new files until you free up space or upgrade your plan; existing files will remain available for download. Very large numbers of small files, extremely high download volumes or automated access patterns may be limited to protect the stability of the Service for other users. We will contact you before applying such limits whenever possible, and we will explain what you can do to bring your usage back within normal levels.

Free accounts that have not been used for twelve months may be placed in an archived state. Archived files can be restored by signing in and following the instructions on the screen. We send reminder emails before an account is archived so that you have time to sign in or download your files.

12d. Export Controls and Sanctions
You agree to comply with all applicable export control and sanctions laws when using the Service. You may not use the Service if you are located in a country or region subject to comprehensive sanctions, or if you are listed on a government list of restricted parties. You are responsible for making sure that any files you store or share through the Service may lawfully be transferred to the countries where you, your collaborators and our infrastructure providers are located.

12e. Accessibility and Support
We aim to make the Service usable by everyone, including people who rely on screen readers, keyboard navigation or high-contrast settings. If you encounter an accessibility barrier, please let our support team know and we will try to provide the information or functionality you need in an alternative format. Support is available by chat and email in English, German and Spanish during regular business hours, and our Help Center contains step-by-step guides for the most common tasks, including restoring deleted files, managing shared folders and changing your plan.

13. Miscellaneous
If any provision of these Terms is found unenforceable, the remaining provisions will remain in full force and effect. Our failure to enforce any right or provision is not a waiver of that right. You may not assign these Terms without our prior written consent; we may assign them in connection with a merger, acquisition or sale of assets. These Terms, together with the Privacy Notice, are the entire agreement between you and Acme regarding the Service.

14. Contact
Questions about these Terms can be sent to our legal team through the contact form in the Help Center, or by mail to Acme Cloud Inc., 100 Example Street, Wilmington, DE 19801, United States.
